title: Electronics Maintenance Officer (Ground) (II) (LtCol to Capt) PMOS, DIR C4
raw_text:
1. MOS 2802, Electronics Maintenance Officer (Ground) (II) (LtCol to Capt)
PMOS, DIR C4

    a. Summary. Ground Electronics Maintenance Officers (2802) manage
maintenance operations in the Marine forces, Marine expeditionary forces,
bases, posts, and stations to include headquarters Marine Corps. They serve
as the Ground Electronics Maintenance Technical Advisor on general staffs.
They may command or assist in commanding a ground maintenance unit or test,
evaluate, and advise in a foreign or joint environment. They provide staff
level planning and technical advice concerning maintenance capabilities and
supportability for ground electronics equipment to the unit, MSC, MAGTF, and
MARFOR commander as well as at the enterprise level. 2802s additionally
serve in a variety of billets (within their occupational field) that include
the development and execution of formal training, integration of maintenance
support into MAGTF operations, management of maintenance policy and doctrine,
and support the requirements development and acquisition processes of ground-
electronics systems and related maintenance support equipment. Marines in
this MOS may be assigned to a BIC (within their occupational field) that has
been coded with one or more DoD Cyber Workforce Framework (DCWF) work role
codes. Please reference DoDI 8140.10, DoDM 8140.10, and the MOS roadmap for
additional training and certification requirements associated with these work
role codes.

       b.    Prerequisites

             (1) Must be selected by the board to LDO.

             (2) Security requirement:     secret security clearance eligibility.

             (3) This MOS may only be assigned to officers previously holding MOS
2805.

        (4) Must meet eligibility and appointment criteria as prescribed in
MCO 1040.42B, WO and LDO accession programs.

       c.    Requirements.   See MOS 2805 requirements.

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (q), Ground Electronics Maintenance Training and Readiness Manual.

       e.    Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code

        (1) First-Line Supervisors/Managers of Mechanics, Installers, and
Repairers 49-1011.

             (2) Managers, All Other 11-9199.

       f.    Related Military Skill.     None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
